Name: Lovely Coffee Maker (CP)
Author: lululovely
Description:
Change the look of the Coffee Maker we got in 1.5 to something a little more worthy of a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8123]Lovely Kitchen[/url]. I made it to match my mod, but it looks great with vanilla or other kitchens too!

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

* * *   INSTRUCTIONS   * * *

- Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Download this mod, unzip it, and place the "[CP] Lovely Coffee Maker" folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
- That's it, you're done!

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

Mods shown: Lovely Coffee Maker and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8123]Lovely Kitchen[/url]*

[size=2]* An updated version of Lovely Kitchen (1.1 or newer) also includes this coffee maker, so no need for both mods if you have that one![/size]
